system.description: You blast an adjacent immediate area with cleansing radiance, inflicting 3 damage on up to three targets in the area—make a separate attack roll against each. If the targets are undead, demons, or creatures of similar ilk, they take 6 damage instead. If any targets are possessed by a spirit, demon, or similar entity, they gain another opportunity to resist the effect and eject their possessor. Action.
